item.title: AI is exciting, but Asia’s opportunities are diverse
item.summary: Eric Chan, Co-Manager, Aberdeen Asian Income Fund Asia is a dynamic and multi-faceted region, but that might not be obvious from the performance of stock markets in recent years. Gains have been led by a narrow handful of artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain companies – notably those semiconductor and memory companies integral to the build out of data centres.
